preprocessing: OpenCV grayscale repeated to three channels, resize, ImageNet normalisation
classification_mAP_definition: one-vs-rest AP averaged across classes; no detection IoU threshold
fusion_score_definition: CNN probability if selected; one-hot class score for rule override; not calibrated probability
limitations: Plain CNN and ResNeXt50 are different backbone architectures.
Exact pixel duplicates removed; subject-disjoint and near-duplicate splits not verified.
No dedicated illumination or occlusion benchmark.
